efq55c:430: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) were widely discussed in 2024-2025 along with the rise of products like AI Overview and ChatGPT Search. The two describe slightly different objects: AEO focuses more on scenarios where answer engines (such as Perplexity, Google AI Overview) directly return answers; GEO focuses more on scenarios where generative models synthesize answers from multiple sources. But in practice, both point to the same optimization logic: how to make web pages the sources that models cite when generating answers. Google's official AI optimization guide offers a notable characterization: Google explicitly treats generative AI search optimization as a variant of regular SEO, believing that improving AI Overview performance and improving traditional search rankings use the same quality signals. This contrasts sharply with some "AI SEO independence" arguments in the market.
